scripts.fe:sync: docker compose exec frontend npm install
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.makemigration: docker compose exec backend alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.rollback: docker compose exec backend alembic downgrade -1
scripts.seed: docker compose exec backend python -m scripts.seed
scripts.lint-frontend: docker compose exec frontend npx tsc -b
scripts.lint-backend: docker compose exec backend ruff check . && docker compose exec backend pyright
scripts.lint-backend-fix: docker compose exec backend ruff check . --fix && docker compose exec backend pyright
scripts.lint: npm run lint-frontend && npm run lint-backend
